task.title: List the owner's devices and sign out a specified device
task.input: M3-T12 shared ReauthDialog and M3-T17 device APIs.
task.output: /admin/account/devices, DevicesContainer/DeviceRow, owner-scoped cursor pages, and single-device revocation.
task.accept: 1) Entry: personal-page Signed-in devices (account-devices-link) -> /admin/account/devices. Data source: GET /api/admin/account/devices. One/two/many pages contain only owner rows, current/expiry/revoked states come from DTOs, and each paged ID appears once. GET does not renew activity (E-70). 2) Clicking device-revoke-{id} reuses ReauthDialog -> POST reauth(DEVICE_REVOKE,target=id) -> POST /api/admin/account/devices/[id]/revoke. Assert the target device's next GET account gets 401 while other unrevoked devices remain valid. Revoking the current device clears the screen and returns to login. Cross-target or consumed grants change nothing (E-73). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.
